faqs.q: Sec. 102-164.5. - Nonresidential water system development charges applicable to developments subject to a water resource contribution discount.
faqs.a:
(a)
Fees in this section are set in accordance with existing agreements to account for
               water resources contributed to the city at no cost to the city.
(b)
Discounted water system development charges under this
section 102-164.5
will apply only until such time as the contributed water resources are exhausted.
(c)

(d)
Water system development charges for irrigated open space based on the following schedule,
               at a per square foot of irrigated area:
Size of Meter
Applicable water system development charges when water resources contributed
Non-water conserving landscaping
$1.54
Water conserving landscaping
$0.82
(e)
For service connections requiring a water tap and meter size larger than six inches,
               the determination of the system development charge, based on the total annual water
               requirement and the water demand characteristics of the property being served, shall
               be at the sole discretion of the utilities director or their duly authorized representative,
               consistent with the provisions of this Article I of Chapter 33. Any such determination
               shall be made available to the user for inspection, upon request.
